content: {"like":["Values strong character development and growth, especially in diverse and quirky casts;","Prefers visually rich, detailed animation with imaginative world‑building;","Enjoys well‑executed action and choreography that blends with humor and tone;","Appreciates subtle environmental or thematic messages woven into storytelling;","Seeks a balance between nostalgic homage and fresh, updated storytelling"],"dislike":["Dislikes over‑exposition, info‑dumping, and lack of subtlety;","Finds poorly developed or flat characters and mismatched voice work off-putting;","Avoids excessive or disruptive musical interludes that interrupt narrative flow;","Criticizes weak or underutilized villains and rushed pacing;","Prefers coherent world‑building without confusing or over‑ambitious plot elements"]}
